name: Do a Barrel Roll
description: Free elytra flight: roll, pitch and yaw around your own axes with the mouse, banking turns, thrust and smoothing, ported from the Do a Barrel Roll mod.
author: Perlin

settings.label: Mod enabled
settings.description: Turns the whole mod on or off.

settings.label: Switch roll and yaw
settings.description: Puts yaw on the mouse and roll on the roll keys, which is closer to vanilla flying. A and D always yaw.

settings.label: Momentum based mouse
settings.description: The mouse sets a turning rate instead of a turning amount, which makes long continuous turns easier.

settings.label: Momentum mouse deadzone
settings.description: Size of the area around the centre where the momentum mouse does nothing.

settings.label: Activation behaviour
settings.description: Vanilla: rolling is available whenever you glide. Hybrid: jump again while gliding to unlock it. Hybrid toggle: jumping again switches it on and off.

settings.label: Enable banking
settings.description: Adds a gentle turn and pull-up while you are rolled, like a plane.

settings.label: Simulate control surface efficacy
settings.description: Scales turning by how fast you are moving along your look direction.

settings.label: Automatic righting
settings.description: Levels you out when you are rolled 90 degrees or less.

settings.label: Enable thrusting
settings.description: W accelerates and S slows you down while flying. Only use this where it is allowed.
